title: Motor de Keywords (matcher.py), Filtros Negativos, Prioritizer, Deduplicador SQLite e DDoS Guard

capabilities: Primary brand query regex matching with word boundaries
Motorcycle brand and model extraction (Honda, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Yamaha)
Restyle kit generation extraction (Gen2, Gen24, Gen25)
Buying intent classification (COMPRA_ATIVA, VIRAL, PROJETO_BUILD, DUVIDA_TECNICA, GERAL)
Instant rejection via negative filters list (NASCAR, F1, racing games, marathons)
Weighted scoring formula (intent 40%, engagement 30%, sentiment 15%, freshness 15%)
Multi-language copy-paste official reply generator (EN, PT, ES) with official https://txrace.com store links
SQLite-backed ACID store with indexed seen_mentions table
Idempotent registration of SHA-256 mention IDs
Exponential backoff multiplier (2^n) on consecutive failures

integration_test.pipeline: Raw mention -> Matcher enrichment -> Prioritizer scoring/reply -> Deduplicator filter/insert -> DDoSGuard pacing
